# KV Sulur Digital Library

KV Sulur Digital Library is the Digital Library Management System for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya AFS Sulur, India. It helps students and staff discover books, manage library activity, and support reading.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://dlmskvsulur.vercel.app/): Overview of the digital library and school reading initiatives.
- [Book catalogue](https://dlmskvsulur.vercel.app/catalog): Search and browse the public book collection.
- [Library help and support](https://dlmskvsulur.vercel.app/support): Contact and support information.
- [Download](https://dlmskvsulur.vercel.app/download): Download the Android or Windows application.

## Notes

Authenticated dashboards and individual student data are private and should not be indexed or treated as public information.
